message:
Wedding DJ or Band? How to Choose

• A DJ: the widest range of songs, the exact recordings, and usually a lower price.
• A band: live energy and spectacle, but it costs more, needs more space and plays a set repertoire.

Or use both: a DJ for the reception and a soloist or trio for the ceremony and cocktails. Either way, they're also your MC.

Read the full guide: https://bridalteam.com/guides/how-to-choose-a-wedding-dj-or-band?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-12&utm_content=2026-12-15-noon-dj-or-band
